items.a: Any framework that produces static output or runs on a Node or edge runtime. There are zero-config presets for about forty of them, and a custom build command covers the rest.
By active CPU time measured in milliseconds, not by wall-clock duration, so a function waiting on a slow upstream request costs almost nothing.

items.q: Can we bring our own domain?
items.a: Yes, on every plan including the free tier. Certificates are issued and renewed automatically.

items.q: What happens if we exceed the included bandwidth?
items.a: Usage above the included amount is billed at the published overage rate. Spend limits and alerts are configurable, and a hard cap can pause the project instead of billing further.

cta.title: Ship your first deployment in minutes
cta.sub: Import a repository and get a live URL before your coffee is cold.

notes: Every eyebrow and small label is set in the monospace face; everything else is the geometric sans. That contrast is the whole typographic system.
The multi-stop mesh gradient (cyan → blue → magenta → amber) is the only decorative chrome in the system. Use it once at hero scale, and never as a card background.
Elevation is three stacked shadows at 4–12% black, never a single heavy drop shadow.
The featured pricing tier flips polarity to solid black against white siblings rather than gaining a colour.
A full 100–1000 colour scale exists in tokens, but marketing surfaces use only the 100, 700 and 1000 steps.
